title: Snap introduces Specs Intelligence, an AI assistant designed to work across iPhone, Mac, and Specs glasses, calling it an "anticipatory AI service" (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Snap introduces Specs Intelligence, an AI assistant designed to work across iPhone, Mac, and Specs glasses, calling it an “anticipatory AI service” — Snap's ‘Specs Intelligence’ is an ‘anticipatory AI service’ available for iOS in preview on Wednesday.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Snap introduces Specs Intelligence, an AI assistant designed to work across iPhone, Mac, and Specs glasses, calling it an “anticipatory AI service”   —  Snap's ‘Specs Intelligence’ is an ‘anticipatory AI service’ available for iOS in preview on Wednesday.
